name: Snackbar
summary: Transient, viewport-anchored message with a single trailing action. Mobile-flavor of Toast — wider, bottom-anchored, action-trailing. Use specifically when the user just performed an action and may need to undo or continue. Auto-dismisses after 5 s by default. One Snackbar at a time per viewport. Distinct from Toast (top-right stack, multiple), Alert (region, persistent), and Banner (page-level state).

action.description: Single trailing action. Almost always an 'Undo' or 'View' button. Snackbars have exactly one action — if you need two, you want a Dialog.

duration.description: Auto-dismiss timer in ms. Pass 0 to disable auto-dismiss.

tone.description: neutral: text.primary on surface.raised — the most common. success: leading CheckCircle in text.accent. danger: leading AlertOctagon in text.error.

anchor.description: bottom-center is the mobile default. bottom-left / bottom-right are desktop variants.

keyboard: Tab - move focus to action (if present)
rules: role='status' + aria-live='polite' for neutral / success. role='alert' + aria-live='assertive' for danger.
Pause auto-dismiss on hover and on focus inside the Snackbar (WCAG 1.4.13 Content on Hover or Focus).
Returns focus to the previously focused element on dismiss.
Honor prefers-reduced-motion: skip the slide-up entry; fade only.
Action label MUST be a verb tied to the message. 'Undo', 'View order', 'Reconnect'.

do: Use after a user action that may need an undo: file delete, archive, send.
Lead with the past-tense verb that describes what happened: 'Order archived', 'Message sent', 'Lane removed'.
Pair with one action. Almost always 'Undo'.
Pause the timer on hover / focus.
Render on top of the bottom safe-area on mobile (above home indicator).
dont: Don't stack multiple Snackbars — queue them and show one at a time.
Don't auto-dismiss critical failures — use a Toast or Alert.
Don't put two actions in a Snackbar. Two actions = Dialog.
Don't use lime fill for tone='success'. Use neutral with text.accent leading glyph.
Don't render a Snackbar without a way to dismiss before the timer (X icon or Escape).

changelog.note: Initial Snackbar contract. Mobile-flavor transient. Single trailing action. Pause-on-hover per WCAG 1.4.13.
